svg.aria-label: Credits for claude-obsidian, the Claude Code plugin for Obsidian. The three bots hold hands and dance a ring round the Obsidian crystal campfire while the credits crawl away into the stars: built by AgriciDaniel, with pull requests and issue reports from the community, MIT license. Then thanks for playing, continue, star the repo.
